name: NEUROCHIMERISM
source:
Minette is a deeply traumatized individual with no hopes for her future.

Vermelia thinks she can change her mind.

NEUROCHIMERISM is a visual novel about a desperate woman-thing and her strange relationship with the only person in the world who wants to help her. No options are off limits, nothing is too much. Even if it means changing her from the inside. Even if it means 'Minette' is no longer Minette.  

[From [url=https://ethersent.itch.io/neurochimerism]itch.io[/url]]
